newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere considers Aerospatiale in Thomson bid.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere considers Aerospatiale in Thomson bid.

text.p: French missiles-to-publishing group Lagardere Groupe said on Wednesday it would take into account the non-consumer electronics and defence activities of state-owned Aerospatiale in its bid for Thomson-CSF.

The finance ministry earlier published terms and conditions of the privatisation of defence electronics company Thomson-CSF, around which it wants to build the largest possible industrial grouping, as part of a defence industry restructuring. pnt

"Like all the candidates, we are ready to take into account the business electronics and defence activities of Aerospatiale in our industrial plan, with the sole concern, for us, of strengthening Thomson-CSF," Lagardere said in a statement.
This was consistent with Lagardere's approach to the Thomson-CSF sale and the spirit of dialogue that it wanted to develop between itself and Aerospatiale, it said.

Lagardere wanted to know what procedure would be used to give it access to the industrial and financial information on Aerospatiale's activities which would be indispensable for a serious bidder, it said.

The government on Tuesday ruled out Aerospatiale as a bidder for Thomson-CSF, either on its own or as part of a group, due to Aerospatiale's state-owned status. But since it would be affected by the outcome of the Thomson-CSF sale, the state welcomed any recommendations from Aerospatiale's chairman, it said.
